Overview

Szczecin is a city in West Pomeranian with a population of 396,168. A major Baltic seaport and industrial center with a unique urban layout, green spaces, and the iconic Pomeranian Dukes’ Castle. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
